items.text: Eagles not planning to place QB Jalen Hurts on IR; sidelined indefinitely by superficial blood clot (calf). First game without him; Tanner McKee starts.
items.why: Superficial blood clot; ultrasound movement; health priority; info gathering continues.
items.implication: McKee start vs CAR; short-term only for now, monitor treatment.
items.opportunity: Healthy top pass-catchers (Smith/Goedert/Wicks) still available; RB thin.

items.text: Ravens play another game without Lamar Jackson (OUT per ETR/Schefter corroboration).
items.implication: Downgrade Ravens pass game; Flowers still viable WR2 per analysts.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (with AD Mitchell) for Week 6.
items.why: Listed OUT on ETR Sunday injury roundup.
items.implication: Jets RB committee/handcuff elevation; avoid Hall.

items.text: Eagles ruled out RB Saquon Barkley for Sunday vs Panthers (hamstring); missed all practice. Will Shipley also OUT (foot/IR).
items.why: Hamstring; missed practice all week; second straight miss.
items.implication: Dameon Pierce expected bulk carries; thin PHI RB room with Shipley OUT.
items.opportunity: Pierce goal-line/early-down; elevated pass-catcher volume possible with McKee.

items.text: PIT without WRs Pittman/Roman Wilson/Skowronek: expect lots of 2-WR sets with DK Metcalf + Germie Bernard (Metcalf heavy). PHI McKee has 4th-string RB Dameon Pierce but healthy top-4 pass-catchers (DeVonta/Goedert/Wicks/Lemon).
items.why: Depth chart absences force personnel; McKee + healthy receivers.
items.implication: Metcalf target monster in 2-WR; PHI pass-catchers viable despite thin RB/McKee.
items.opportunity: Metcalf routes/snaps up; PHI WR/TE share with no Hurts/Saquon.

items.text: Unclear on Qs AJ Brown (ankle), TreVeyon Henderson (ankle), DJ Moore (shoulder). Tyler Warren (groin) Friday Q add. Probable-like: Caleb Williams, DK Metcalf, Chris Olave, Rico Dowdle. Highly doubt Henderson high-ankle given practice.
items.why: Practice reports + Friday add for Warren; illness tags for Metcalf/Olave look light.
items.implication: Monitor Brown/Henderson/Moore closely; lean start on probable Qs.
items.opportunity: If Brown sits, NE WR targets open; Warren Q risks IND TE; Metcalf heavy if plays.

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT (with Tyquan Thornton) Week 6.
items.opportunity: Increased routes for remaining KC receivers.

items.text: IN clearances: DeVonta Smith, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty (plus Nailor, Coker, Penix, MHJ Texans). Smith returns healthy for McKee.
items.why: ETR Sunday IN list after practice/reports.
items.implication: Smith boosts PHI pass game with McKee; Lamb/Jeanty full go.
items.opportunity: Smith targets with top-4 healthy; reverse any prior handcuff bumps.

items.text: Buccaneers officially ruled out QB Baker Mayfield vs Pittsburgh; rookie Jalon Daniels starts again.
items.implication: TB pass game downgrade; Egbuka etc. impacted.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey has no injury designation (cleared/IN) for Sunday at KC; ETR lists IN with Quentin Johnston.
items.implication: Full role expected; start with confidence.

items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) vs Rams; rest for long-term healing.
items.why: Ankle; rest to heal long-term per Rapoport.

items.text: Packers RB Josh Jacobs removed from commissioner exempt list Monday; eligible to practice/play Week 7. Investigation remains open.
items.why: League removal from exempt; probe ongoing but playable next week.
items.implication: Stash/roster for W7 return; GB RB situation stabilizes soon.
items.opportunity: Potential lead back return impacts handcuffs.

items.text: LOVE Mike Evans (WR4 vs WSH), Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH). Washington D is buffet for pass-catchers; London usage bankable.
items.implication: Prioritize in lineups; Evans WR4 overall for Berry.
items.opportunity: High target share expected vs weak secondary.

items.text: LOVE Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ) for volume vs leaky run Ds. LOVE Purdy (QB2 vs WSH), Stafford (QB4 vs ARI), Jordan Love (QB5 vs DAL) in shootouts. Hates: Waddle, Egbuka, Pitts, Dobbins, Nix, Herbert.
items.why: Elite recent usage/goal-line for RBs; high-scoring spots for QBs. Hates due to tough Ds/QB issues/low totals.
items.implication: Start loved RBs/QBs; fade hated in tough spots (Nix vs SEA, Herbert low total).
items.opportunity: Kyren elite usage; Javonte GL work.
